home.title: Excel → JSON
home.subtitle: Convert your spreadsheets to JSON, reshape the structure, test it against your API and visualize it as a graph or a database schema.
home.headline: Turn a spreadsheet into the JSON your API expects.

demo.hint: Tick a column header to move it into a nested object.
demo.keyTaken: Another column already uses this key.

steps.heading: From file to API in four steps

convert.title: Convert
convert.text: Drop an Excel file. Each row of the first sheet becomes an object, keyed by its column headers.

reshape.title: Reshape
reshape.text: Group columns into nested objects and rename keys at any level, or start from a JSON file.

send.title: Send
send.text: Send the result to your endpoint with the method and headers you choose, and read the response.

visualize.title: Visualize
visualize.text: Explore the data as a graph, infer a database schema and export it as SQL, Mermaid or Excel.

closing.title: Create an account to start converting.
closing.text: The tools open once you sign in. Your files are read in the browser, never uploaded.

login.signInSubtitle: Sign in to keep converting and testing your data.
login.signUpSubtitle: Convert spreadsheets, reshape the JSON and test it against your API.
login.accountCreated: Account created. Enter your password to sign in.
login.showcaseText: Group spreadsheet columns into the nested objects your API expects, then send them in one click.
login.showcaseFigure: The city and zip columns of a spreadsheet grouped into an address object in the JSON output

errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this email.
errors.invalidData: Enter a user name, a valid email and a password of at least {{min}} characters.
errors.noServerResponse: The server didn't respond. Check your connection and try again.

dropzone.dropExcel: Drag and drop your Excel file
dropzone.dropJson: Drag and drop your JSON file
dropzone.selectFromComputer: select a file to upload from your computer

errors.excelRead: Could not read the Excel file

jsonPreview.itemLooksLike: Each item in your JSON file looks like:

structure.title: Modify JSON structure
structure.keyPlaceholder: Give a key to these values…
structure.moveToTop: Move {{name}} back to the top level

errors.keyMustBeText: This field must be text, not a number.

visualizer.dropHint: drop a .json or Excel file here
visualizer.emptyGraph: Load a JSON or Excel file above, or send data here from the Excel to JSON, JSON structure or Test API pages with the Visualize button.

graph.help: click a nested key to collapse it, a value to copy its path
graph.truncated: graph truncated, collapse nodes or show fewer items

schema.fromJsonHelp: Tables inferred from the data: nested objects and arrays become related tables.
schema.sqlPlaceholder: Paste CREATE TABLE statements (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server)…
schema.emptyJson: Load some JSON data first, or switch to From SQL.
schema.help: Double-click a table name to rename it · change a column type with its selector · select a table to highlight its relations

parseErrors.duplicateTable: Table "{{table}}" is defined twice, the last definition is used.

export.noSchema: No schema yet: load JSON data or draw a diagram from SQL first.
export.previewTruncated: Preview of the first {{shown}} lines out of {{total}}. Copy and Download contain everything.

empty.title: Open a spreadsheet
empty.text: Drop an Excel, CSV or ODS file anywhere on this page, or choose one from your computer. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded.
empty.dropHere: Drop the file to open it

errors.notSpreadsheet: {{name}} isn't a spreadsheet. Choose an .xlsx, .xls, .csv or .ods file.
errors.oneFile: Drop one file at a time.
errors.unreadable: {{name}} couldn't be read. Check that it isn't damaged or password protected.
errors.emptySheet: This sheet is empty. Pick another sheet below or open another file.
errors.keyTaken: Another key at this level already has this name.
errors.sameLevel: Select keys from the same level to group them.
errors.concatTwo: Select at least two keys to combine them.
errors.concatFields: Only simple keys can be combined, not groups or combined keys.

file.resetConfirm: Undo every change to the keys of this sheet?

keys.title: JSON keys
keys.help: Tick columns in the sheet or keys below to group them under a new key. Click a key to rename it.
keys.included: In the JSON. Click to leave it out
keys.excluded: Left out. Click to include it

preview.title: Result
preview.firstItems: The first {{shown}} of {{total}} objects. Copy and download include all of them.
preview.nothing: Every column is left out. Include at least one to see the result.

concat.title: Combine into one key
concat.orderHint: Drag the keys, or use the arrows, to change the order of the values.
concat.skipEmptyHint: No separator is added for a missing value, so “Louis” stays “Louis” instead of “Louis ”.

apiTester.hint: Ctrl+Enter sends the request from anywhere on the page.

via.label: Send from
via.browserTitle: The request goes straight from your browser. It reaches localhost, but the API must allow this site (CORS).
via.serverTitle: The XLSX server sends the request for you. It works with APIs that block browsers, but only reaches public addresses.

body.notSent: {{method}} requests don't send a body. Choose POST, PUT or PATCH to send it.
body.restore: Restore the data you sent here
body.placeholder: Paste or type the JSON to send
body.imported: The body holds the data you sent from the previous page.

headers.name: Name
headers.note: Content-Type is only sent with a body.

auth.noneNote: Choose a type to add an Authorization header.
auth.note: Added as the Authorization header. It is kept in this tab only and cleared when you leave the page.

response.title: Response
response.idleText: Enter a URL and press Send. The status, time, headers and body of the response show up here.
response.truncated: The body was cut at 5 MB.
response.browserHeaders: Browsers only show the headers the API allows them to read.

errors.emptyUrl: Enter the URL of the API to call.
errors.invalidUrl: This URL isn't valid. It should look like https://api.example.com/customers.
errors.invalidBody: The body isn't valid JSON. Fix it or clear it before sending.
errors.bodyAt: The body isn't valid JSON: check line {{line}}, column {{column}}.

network.title: No response from {{host}}
network.text: The server may be down or the URL wrong. Often the API simply doesn't accept calls from a browser on another site (CORS). Sending it from the XLSX server avoids that.

timeout.title: {{host}} took longer than 30 seconds
timeout.text: Try again later, or check that the URL points to the right server.

privateAddress.title: The XLSX server can't reach {{host}}
privateAddress.text: It only calls public addresses. To call localhost or a private network, send from this browser.

dnsFailed.title: {{host}} wasn't found
dnsFailed.text: Check the spelling of the address.

unreachable.title: {{host}} couldn't be reached
unreachable.text: The XLSX server couldn't connect to it. Check the URL and that the API is online.

invalidUrl.title: This URL isn't valid
invalidUrl.text: It should start with http:// or https://.

invalidRequest.title: The request couldn't be sent
invalidRequest.text: Check the method and the URL, then try again.

unauthorized.title: Your session has expired
unauthorized.text: Sign in again to keep testing.

reshape.resetConfirm: Go back to the original structure? Every change is undone.

empty.title: Reshape your JSON
empty.text: Open a JSON file or paste JSON to rename keys, nest them into objects, flatten nested objects or leave keys out. Your data stays in your browser.

errors.invalidJson: This isn't valid JSON. Check the brackets, quotes and commas.
errors.invalidJsonAt: This isn't valid JSON: check line {{line}}, column {{column}}.
errors.emptyArray: The array is empty. There are no objects to reshape.
errors.notObjects: The JSON must be an object or an array of objects to be reshaped.
errors.notJsonFile: {{name}} isn't a .json file. To convert a spreadsheet, use Excel to JSON.

reshape.keysHelp: Tick keys to group them under a new key, or ungroup a nested object to flatten it. Click a key to rename it.
